results.title: US-Iran Talks: Trump says he's 'not looking to kill people', announces fresh negotiations from Monday
results.description: The US President revealed that diplomatic engagements involving Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar and Iran led him to halt what was originally planned as a "massive attack" on Friday.

results.title: #HEALTH: Small habits, big impact on diabetes
results.description: MALAYSIA is facing a dual epidemic of obesity and type 2 diabetes. One in two adults in the country is overweight or obese according to the National Health and Morbidity Survey (NHMS) 2024.
